queries: WITH country_counts AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_college AS pc JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), overall AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_records, AVG(record_count) AS average_count FROM country_counts) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cc.record_count), 0) AS total_record_count, AVG(1.0 * cc.record_count / o.total_records) AS average_share, AVG(cc.record_count - o.average_count) AS average_excess FROM country_counts AS cc CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE cc.record_count > o.average_count
